description:
Put 2 to 4 packages to Hook Detector's users, who pick the one they would click, blind.
    Closes at votes_wanted or after 7 days. 2 credits, given back when a picture cannot be
    stored. Results with get_poll. Same as POST /v1/polls.

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; the same key and request within 24 hours answer the saved remix and charge nothing; the same key with another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

options.description: 2 to 4 packages, each {title, thumbnail}: a title of 1 to 100 characters and a JPEG, PNG or WebP in base64 or an i.ytimg.com URL
options.title: Options
